mentions.name: Raylib bindings for s7 Scheme
mentions.description: This project provides bindings exposing the raylib game programming library to s7 Scheme, letting Scheme code call raylib functionality. Most of the binding code was written with AI assistance because it was conceptually simple but boring, and the work was done for the sake of understanding.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on binding raylib to s7 scheme and implementing a kanren on top of it basically just for the sake of understanding.
